requirements.statement: Complete linkage defines the intercluster dissimilarity as the largest pairwise dissimilarity between an observation in one cluster and an observation in the other cluster.

places.quote: $$\text{complete: } \max_{i \in A,\, j \in B} d_{ij} \qquad \text{single: } \min_{i \in A,\, j \in B} d_{ij}$$
- **Complete**: maximum distance between any pair of points in the two clusters

requirements.statement: The Euclidean distance between two points is the square root of the sum of squared differences in their coordinates.
